description: A shell script that contains a series of Git test cases for verifying work tree status reporting, conflict handling, and related behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided commands, and verifies they succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, and verifies that it does.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files and messages.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the commit timestamp to ensure unique commit times.
